wa_2025.validation_method: like-for-like: NISAR new-flood mask vs OPERA DSWx-S1 new flood (water on 2025-12-15/17 AND NOT water 2025-12-01..07), cloud-free on both dates; NISAR swath ~ AOI
wa_2025.validation_method_raw: all water: NISAR flood mask vs every OPERA DSWx-S1 water pixel 2025-12-15/17 over the AOI (includes permanent/pre-existing water, so FN is inflated)
wa_2025.hls_method: all water, OPERA DSWx-HLS (optical) 2025-12-15/17, cloud-free pixels only; 92.9% cloud -> reference mostly unobserved; not comparable to iou/f1
wa_2025.cloud_pct_source: OPERA DSWx-HLS cloud class (WTR 253) 2025-12-15/17 over the AOI

forecast_lead_time.skipped_reason: no SMAP S for D-1 (series starts at the window start)
forecast_lead_time.alignment: L28b: issue D 00Z; observed IMERG days <= D-1 only; GFS D 00Z run calendar days D..D+3; frame D+k = 3-day sum ending D+k
forecast_lead_time.basis: GFS-forecast replay TPI: R_fc = score(3-day sum ending D+k: obs IMERG days <= D-1 + GFS days D..D+k) vs case climatology, S held at D-1, T static; critical = AOI max over slide/flood > 0.6 for depicted date <= anchor
forecast_lead_time.denominator_note: quote n_warned of n_eligible_issue_days; issue days after the anchor cannot warn by definition

wa_2025.opera_fn_diagnosis: raw FN 1.19M px = permanent/pre-existing water (pre_water 1.21M px) which our new-flood mask correctly excludes; like-for-like FN drops to 60.7k px

landslide_hit.definition: share of inventory points with TPI_slide >= 0.6 (Critical)
landslide_hit.note: TPI_slide sampled at the 16,027 RS landslide inventory points; at 1 km scale slope flattening kept the same series below 0.6.
